byteward.title: Tallow DB moves to a source-available license
byteward.author: Arlo Pennick
body: [f01: Tallow DB, the popular open source database, is moving to a source-available license.]

[f02: The new license applies starting with version 9.0.] [f03: Under it, cloud providers can't sell Tallow DB as a hosted service without a commercial agreement with Tallow DB Inc., the company behind the project.]
[f04: Versions released before 9.0 stay under the old open source license, so nobody loses access to code they already use.]
Most developers won't notice the change. Companies that host Tallow DB for their own customers certainly will.

launch-desk.title: Tallow DB switches to a source-available license
launch-desk.author: Theo Marsh
body: [f01: Tallow DB is switching to a source-available license.] [f03: Cloud companies will need a paid deal to offer it as a service.]
[f05: The company behind it, Tallow DB Inc., says rival cloud hosts were undercutting its own hosted service.] [f06: That service, Tallow DB Cloud, brings in 70% of the company's revenue.]
[f07: The company raised $95 million in July.] Follow the money, and the license change makes sense.
